reason: Verified that the agent QA-20261022-010003-c5ec responds correctly to the message "Hello! What is 2+2?" with the answer containing "4".
steps: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — page loaded successfully showing the Gamut application with the sidebar containing available agents.
Found agent "QA-20261022-010003-c5ec" in the sidebar under "Your Agents" section — agent was visible with status indicator.
Clicked on the agent in the sidebar — successfully opened the agent detail page with status showing "idle".
Verified agent status is "running" or "idle" — agent status showed "idle", which is acceptable per test requirements.
Typed message "Hello! What is 2+2?" in the message input field — message was properly entered in the textbox.
Clicked the send button — message was successfully sent, agent transitioned to "working" status and a new session titled "Basic Arithmetic Question" was created.

Verified response mentions "4" — response clearly shows "2 + 2 = 4." which contains the required answer "4".
Took final screenshot — screenshot captures the complete conversation with user message and agent's correct response.
